name: contrast-forced-gamut
note: Preference and output features against emulated environments: prefers-contrast more vs no-preference, forced-colors active vs none, color-gamut srgb vs p3 (rec2020 stays false for an srgb display), and an and-composition of contrast and forced-colors. Each viewport states the environment to both engines through CDP feature overrides and MediaEnvironment inputs. The matching rules size the boxes rather than paint them: forced-colors emulation overrides author colors (Chrome computes canvas colors), so background-color is not a comparable oracle under (forced-colors: active); width is untouched by forced-colors.
